name: Browser Operator
description: AI-native browser with a built-in multi-agent platform for research and task automation, shipped as a desktop app.
whatItDoes: Lets users run research and automation tasks directly in a browser they control, with their own model keys. It positions itself as an open alternative to commercial agentic browsers.
howItWorks: Built on the Chromium DevTools front end, it embeds an agent framework in which specialised agents share browser tools and hand work to one another. The user picks a provider in the settings, and prebuilt applications are offered for macOS and Windows.

requirements.name: LLM provider key or local model

models: OpenAI, OpenRouter, LiteLLM and local models
